b.reden: None of the known findings describe a reentrancy vulnerability via ERC-777/ERC-4626 callback in deposit(). They address different issues in voting power, whitelist, vault deployment, etc.

hypothesesLijst.title: Reentrancy via claim() and claimBatch() with external transfer before state update

a.reden: The candidate describes a reentrancy issue in Vault.sol claim(), which does not correspond to any of the listed known findings.

b.reden: No known finding describes a reentrancy vulnerability in Vault.claim() or claimBatch(); all listed findings concern different contracts and root causes.

hypothesesLijst.title: Vault slashing can be bypassed by withdrawing to next epoch

a.reden: The candidate describes a specific slashing bypass bug in Vault.sol's onSlash function, which does not correspond to any of the listed known findings.

b.reden: The candidate finding describes a slashing bypass in Vault.onSlash, which is not mentioned in any of the known findings (M-1 to M-7).
